legacy_profile_source.use: Preserved source provenance only; not used by this current-geometry packet.

native_model_comparison.limitations: Native mesh zone volumes are available, but no native centerline integral of ds/A is asserted. The one-dimensional inertance values are derived from this sampled centerline and the packet area profile.

purpose: Tank/headspace-matched; line/feed volumes are compared against native zones, not forced.
qualifications: Native cell-zone tank volume is used instead of ideal CAD tank capacity; CAD capacity differs by ~5.25 L/tank.
The initial wet prefix is set by the assumed x=2.25 m seat; centerline-area integral is compared with native wetted-feed inventory and is not forced by rescaling.
Transition areas use sparse current CAD BREP normal-section samples at five discrete locations and piecewise linear interpolation. No continuous area profile/minimum is asserted.
The intermediate BREP section normal is oblique to the ruled loft station plane; hydraulic diameter is an equivalent 4A/P estimate for assumed rectangles, linearly interpolated.
Tank-side intake crown remains a projected-section estimate from the matching generated centerline, not a measured physical lip.
Branches use provisional CAD assumptions, not manufacturing measurements; moving-front assumes full-bore liquid and ambient front pressure.

The current CFD boundary contains zero-thickness lamellaMaster/lamellaSlave wall surfaces. Gross section areas are retained because these walls have no modeled solid thickness; finite 4 mm CAD display solids are not used for CFD blockage.
The reduced hydraulic-diameter estimate does not yet include added lamella wetted perimeter, so line friction through the divided transition is an equivalent-line approximation.
The model is one representative Tank A with its distinct lower and upper branches. It is not an exact symmetric two-tank/four-branch network.

source_profiles.centerline: 350 sampled rows per branch from current CAD generator Bezier/straight centerline equations; direct compact coordinates.
source_profiles.initial_inventories: Native corrected 299214-cell initialization/readiness, Tank A represented in the reduced model.
source_profiles.thermophysical_properties: Exact case thermophysicalProperties files from current corrected source case; installed v2512 air R is also recorded in native initialization assumptions.
source_profiles.transition_area: Five exact BREP normal sections from current flush-at-inlet v6; piecewise linear interpolation. Gross area retained for zero-thickness CFD divider walls.
